subject.title: fix(heartbeat): task prompts reach the model

question: Should the generic prompt splitter recognize the queued-user marker as a stable structural wrapper and promote its enclosed scheduled heartbeat task back to the active model prompt?
rationale: The final fix is focused and tests the demonstrated failure, but it makes a human-readable queued-turn marker part of a cross-module model-prompt compatibility contract that needs owner intent.

options.title: Accept the wrapper contract
options.body: Confirm ordinary queued messages remain context-only, require final-head natural scheduled proof, and merge after current-main checks.

options.title: Move recovery upstream
options.body: Keep the splitter marker-agnostic and change queued/orphan turn assembly to carry an explicit active model prompt for scheduled heartbeat work.

recommendation.title: Accept the wrapper contract
recommendation.body: Confirm ordinary queued messages remain context-only, require final-head natural scheduled proof, and merge after current-main checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The current splitter and adjacent model/transcript separation history most strongly route this compatibility decision to them.
